1.w: I [am] the man [who] has seen affliction by the rod of His wrath;

2.w: He has led me and has made me walk [in] darkness, and not light;

3.w: surely He turns back against me; He turns over His hand all the day.

4.w: He has worn out my flesh and my skin; he has broken my bones.

5.w: He has built up against me and surrounded me with bitterness and weariness;

6.w: in dark places He has settled me, like the dead of old.

7.w: He has put a hedge around me, so that I cannot get out; He has made heavy my chain of bronze;

8.w: even when I cry out and call for help, He shuts out my prayer.

9.w: He has blocked off my ways with cut stone, my paths He has made crooked.

10.w: A bear lying in ambush He [is] to me, a lion in hiding places;

11.w: my ways He has turned aside, and has torn me apart; He has set me as a desolation.

12.w: He has bent His bow and stood me up as the target for an arrow.

13.w: He has brought into my kidneys the sons of His quiver;

14.w: I have become a laughingstock to all my people, their taunt all the day.

15.w: He has filled me with bitterness; He has made me drink wormwood.

16.w: And He has broken my teeth with gravel; He has covered me with ashes.

17.w: My soul has been rejected from peace; I have forgotten good,

18.w: and I say, “My strength has perished, and also my hope from YHWH!”

19.w: Remember my affliction and my wandering, the wormwood and the gall!

20.w: It remembers well and sinks—My soul within me.

21.w: This I turn to my mind; upon thus I have hope.

22.w: Because of the loving devotion of YHWH we are not consumed, for His mercies are not finished.

23.w: [They are] new in the mornings—great [is] Your faithfulness!

24.w: “My portion [is] YHWH,” says my soul, “Upon thus do I hope in Him.”

25.w: Good [is] YHWH to those waiting for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.

26.w: And [it is] good to wait and be silent for the salvation of YHWH;

27.w: [it is] good for a man that he should bear the yoke in his youth.

28.w: Let him sit alone and be silent when it is laid upon him.

29.w: Let him put in the dust his mouth; perhaps there is hope!

30.w: Let him give [his] cheek to the one striking him; let him be filled with reproach!

31.w: For the Lord will not reject [us] forever;

32.w: for though He may bring grief, He will show compassion according to the abundance of His loving devotion;

33.w: for he has not afflicted with His heart or grieved the sons of man.

34.w: To crush under one’s feet all the prisoners of the earth,

35.w: to stretch aside justice for a man before the face of the Most High,

36.w: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord does not approve.

37.w: Who [is] this having spoken, and it came to pass, if the Lord [did] not command [it]?

38.w: From the mouth of the Most High [does] not come forth the bad and the good?

39.w: Why should complain a living man, a man for his sins?

40.w: Let us search out our ways, and let us seek, and turn back to YHWH!

41.w: Let us lift our heart with [our] hands to God in the heavens:

42.w: “We have transgressed and we have rebelled; You have not forgiven.”

43.w: You have covered in anger and pursued us; You have killed; You have not pitied.

44.w: You have covered Yourself with a cloud, from passing through a prayer.

45.w: You have made us offscouring and refuse in the midst of the nations.

46.w: They have opened their mouths against us—all our enemies;

47.w: terror and pitfall have come upon us, desolation and destruction!

48.w: Streams of water run down my eyes over the destruction of the daughter of my people!

49.w: My eye pours forth, and it does not cease—without numbing—

50.w: until YHWH looks down and sees from the heavens!

51.w: My eye bring grief to my soul because of all the daughters of my city.

52.w: My enemies have hunted me relentlessly like a bird, without cause;

53.w: They have cut off my life in the pit, and they threw stones at me;

54.w: the waters flowed over my head; I said I have been cut off!

55.w: I called on Your name, O YHWH, out of the depths of the Pit,

56.w: You heard my voice: “Do not hide Your ear from my sighing, from my cry!”

57.w: You drew near on the day I called you, you said, “Do not fear!”

58.w: You have pleaded, O Lord, the pleadings of my soul; You have redeemed my life!

59.w: You have seen, O YHWH, the wrong done to me; vindicate my cause!

60.w: You have seen all their vengeance, all their plots against me.

61.w: You have heard their taunt, O YHWH, all their plots against me,

62.w: the lips of my assailants and their murmuring against me all the day,

63.w: their sitting down, and their rising up—Look! I [am] their mocking song.

64.w: May You repay to them a recompense, O YHWH, according to the work of their hands!

65.w: May You give to them a covering for the heart—Your curse [be] upon them!

66.w: May You pursue [them] in Your anger and destroy them from under the heavens, O YHWH!
